clusters.title: Diesel / harvest / food logistics
clusters.status: Active cost-pressure cluster; downstream service failure unproven
clusters.interaction: Fuel is a common input; harvest windows limit shedding; carrier cash timing can propagate strain.
clusters.independence: EIA observations, USDA forecast and farmer/freight interviews are different evidence types; shared fuel shock is counted once.

clusters.title: Bay Area transit finance / essential access / future repair
clusters.status: Documented fiscal exposure; downstream access loss conditional
clusters.interaction: Temporary funds and delayed recurring revenue can constrain multiple operators together; borrowing/deferrals shift load into future recovery.
clusters.independence: BART and SFMTA are distinct budgets but share regional revenue conditions. Their risks are correlated.

clusters.title: Sulfur / phosphate / farm nutrient access
clusters.status: Unexpected dependency; production-loss cascade not established
clusters.interaction: Sulfur input strain can squeeze phosphate margins while potash has stronger output; neither proves all-nutrient shortage.
clusters.independence: Producer subsections are one disclosure, not multiple independent confirmations.
clusters.adaptation: Diversify agronomically suitable nutrients and procurement; independent producer checks pending.

clusters.title: Local utility recovery / equipment / water and care continuity
clusters.status: High-consequence scenario; current compound failure not established
clusters.interaction: Enough generation does not guarantee rapid replacement of a failed local asset; prolonged local outage could challenge water/care.
clusters.independence: Grid assessment, legal changes and old manufacturing announcement do not demonstrate a synchronized present crisis.

clusters.title: Social grievance / organized intimidation / institutional paralysis
clusters.status: Not activated; current local evidence insufficient
clusters.interaction: Mechanism requires corroborated organization, capability and harmful conduct, not anger or identity.
clusters.independence: Annual reported crime trend and recovery coordination do not measure current local rhetoric or institutional trust.

classification_rules.destructive_failure: Essential function is lost without adequate replacement.

classification_rules.creative_transition: Released or convertible assets support a better way to preserve function.
classification_rules.healthy_replacement_growth: Verified useful capacity replaces or expands an inadequate function.

ACTIVE_SIGNALS.title: Diesel cost pressure
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.observation: Sept 14 retail diesel: US $6.285/gal (+$0.318/week), California $8.039 (+$0.275/week); taxes included.
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.implication: Essential transport and harvest cash needs rise before any physical rationing occurs.

ACTIVE_SIGNALS.title: Thin but rebuilding distillate stocks
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.observation: Sept 11 stocks 107.859m barrels, up from 103.391m Aug 21 through three weekly builds; 13% below five-year seasonal average. Refinery utilization 96.8%.
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.implication: Cost stress coexists with recovery in stocks and limited refinery headroom; regional deliverability remains a gap.

ACTIVE_SIGNALS.title: Below-100m stock forecast is not yet observed
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.observation: Sept 9 STEO projected September distillate stocks below 100m barrels; later Sept 11 weekly observation remains above that level.
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.implication: Do not report the forecast as current stock or use stock/use as a countdown to exhaustion.

ACTIVE_SIGNALS.title: Farm operating costs tighten
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.observation: USDA forecasts 2026 fertilizer/lime/soil conditioner expense +15.3%, fuel/oils +28.8%; inflation-adjusted net farm income -5.5%, still above 2006–25 average. Direct payments forecast $47.4bn.
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.confidence: high that forecast was issued; medium realized outcome
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.implication: Cash-flow exposure differs by farm; aid/payment timing and crop receipts buffer some producers.

ACTIVE_SIGNALS.title: Cereal buffer substantial but unevenly accessible
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.observation: FAO forecasts 2026/27 cereal stocks/use 31.6%, historically comfortable; Black Sea logistics constraints may accumulate stocks behind export bottlenecks.
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.implication: Global abundance does not guarantee delivery or affordable food in a specific place.

ACTIVE_SIGNALS.title: Sulfur pressure on phosphate
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.observation: Nutrien attributes phosphate pressure to sulfur costs and availability. Its Q2 P2O5 operating rate was 75% vs 79%; H1 output increased to 656k tonnes from 615k.
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.confidence: high company metrics; medium broad applicability
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.implication: Unexpected feedstock dependency deserves a separate phosphate watch; a universal fertilizer shutdown is unsupported.

ACTIVE_SIGNALS.title: Potash capacity offers a buffer
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.observation: Nutrien reports record H1 potash production, 7.656m tonnes vs 6.820m a year earlier.
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.implication: Output is evidence of supply strength; available uncommitted export surplus remains unknown. Potash is not interchangeable with phosphate.

ACTIVE_SIGNALS.title: BART fiscal bridge preserves service with future costs
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.observation: FY27 budget assumes November revenue measure passage and April 2027 receipts; bridge includes $52m capital deferrals and $89m borrowing. Current service preserved; alternative service plan conditional.
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.implication: Liquidity bridge buys time while transferring some load to future budgets and asset renewal.

ACTIVE_SIGNALS.title: Muni finance shares the regional constraint
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.observation: April 21 adopted budget protects regular Muni/paratransit in FY26-27; significant cuts from FY27-28 remain conditional on funding. Agency describes $307m deficit.
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.implication: Another transit operator cannot be assumed to be a funded spare compartment.

ACTIVE_SIGNALS.title: California generation adequacy improved in planning
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.observation: May assessment models 2,547 MW margin relative to its reliability target. It includes anticipated additions and does not cover all coincident extreme events or local constraints.
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.implication: Downgrade statewide insufficiency assumption; assess local recovery/fuel/equipment separately.

ACTIVE_SIGNALS.title: Industrial output contradicts blanket decline
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.observation: August total industrial output flat month/month and +1.4% year/year; manufacturing -0.3% month/month and +0.9% year/year.
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.implication: Sector-specific stress is plausible; broad industrial collapse not established.

ACTIVE_SIGNALS.title: Credit access varies by borrower
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.observation: Q2 bank survey: C&I standards basically unchanged across firm sizes; consumer and nonbank lending remain relatively tight by historical comparison.
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.implication: Do not describe all business credit as freezing; household and nonbank financing deserve distinct checks.

ACTIVE_SIGNALS.title: Labor reallocation and healthcare growth divergence
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.observation: August manufacturing employment +16k, healthcare +13k versus prior 12-month average +32k; information employment -23k. Transportation/warehousing little changed.
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.confidence: high preliminary estimates; low causal attribution
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.implication: No evidence released workers can immediately fill licensed or technical roles; healthcare headcount does not measure care access.

ACTIVE_SIGNALS.title: Reported hate-crime trend improved in prior year
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.observation: FBI matched reporting sample: incidents fell 7.0% from 11,404 in 2024 to 10,606 in 2025. Total all-reporting incidents 10,881 is a different sample.
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.confidence: high reported matched trend; low for 2026 climate
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.implication: Retain improving evidence. Current rhetoric, organization, intimidation and institutional trust remain unmeasured.

ACTIVE_SIGNALS.title: Caribbean regional recovery coordination grows
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.observation: CDEMA recovery roster launched with first orientation for 14 experts on Aug 26; announced Aug 27 and published Aug 30.
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.implication: Institutional complementary capacity; roster count is not a verified deployment commitment.

ACTIVE_SIGNALS.title: European electricity seasonal buffer
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.observation: ENTSO-E summer assessment finds broadly favorable adequacy, with specific risks in Moldova, Ireland, Malta and Cyprus.
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.freshness: Summer 2026 assessment; exact publication date unverified
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.implication: Cross-border coordination is a buffer; live export reserve must be measured by time and interconnector.

ACTIVE_SIGNALS.title: Metal trade rules create differentiated exposure
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.observation: June proclamation adjusted specified metal-product duties effective June 8. July 20 authorized reduced-duty incentives tied to approved new/refurbished primary-aluminum production.
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.confidence: high existence of measures; low project-level impact
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.implication: Need product-origin-specific quotes, HTS and delivery evidence before attributing repair delays to tariffs.

ACTIVE_SIGNALS.title: Grid manufacturing expansion has lead time
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.observation: Reuters reported a Sept 2025 Hitachi $1bn US grid-manufacturing plan including a Virginia transformer facility targeted for 2028.
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.implication: Planned industrial growth cannot be counted as a September 2026 spare transformer.

ACTIVE_SIGNALS.title: Harvest and refrigerated freight cost propagation
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.observation: Sept 18 reporting describes named farmers absorbing fuel increases and elevated refrigerated freight prices; some operators already adapting equipment use.
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.implication: Observed price/cash-flow transmission warrants deepening; predicted trucking bankruptcies remain unconfirmed.

ACTIVE_SIGNALS.title: October European crude-delivery report needs corroboration
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.observation: Reuters relays Bloomberg report of October supply cancellations affecting at least two refiners, explicitly unverified by Reuters; alternatives also reported.
ACTIVE_SIGNALS.implication: Material follow-up lead; do not present multiple outlets in one chain as independent evidence.

edges.mechanism: Fuel paid before freight invoices settle can squeeze carrier working capital.
buffers: Surcharges, contracts, route consolidation, stock recovery
thresholds: Actual payment mismatch persists through billing cycle; named essential lanes lose reliable service
substitutes: Rail for suitable routes; pooled loads; appropriate electric routes
edges.uncertainty: No representative carrier failure wave verified
edges.confirm: Carrier filings and repeated missed/declined loads linked to fuel cash flow
edges.falsify: Stable service, timely surcharges and adequate working capital despite prices
edges.activation_status: Cost link observed; capacity-loss branch conditional

edges.mechanism: Higher delivered cost or missed windows can reduce food access and increase spoilage.
buffers: Multiple suppliers, existing distribution, some contracts
thresholds: Missed perishable deliveries and lack of qualified alternate carrier
substitutes: Food aggregation; local distribution; nutritionally suitable shelf-stable mix
edges.uncertainty: Rates indicate pressure; local spoilage or empty shelves not established
edges.confirm: Delivery reliability/temperature failures coincide with lane capacity losses
edges.falsify: On-time delivery and food availability persist while rates stabilize

edges.mechanism: Essential field operations have low short-run deferrability and consume working capital.
buffers: Crop receipts, aid, stored inputs, equipment adaptation
thresholds: Farm unable to finance timely operations; verified work delayed past agronomic window
substitutes: Shared equipment and route planning; suitable equipment substitution
edges.time_horizon: Harvest weeks; next season for reinvestment
edges.uncertainty: Aggregate farm forecast not individual liquidity; on-road price not off-road price
edges.confirm: Farm-level delayed harvest/input purchases tied to operating liquidity
edges.falsify: Timely harvest, supported margins and payments prevent disruption
edges.activation_status: Cost transmission observed; production loss conditional

edges.mechanism: Insufficient timely nutrient access can alter application and future yields; nutrients differ.
buffers: Existing stocks, diverse vendors, soil testing and agronomic efficiency
thresholds: Verified order rationing/delivery delay during application window
substitutes: Agronomically equivalent sources; safe nutrient recovery longer term
edges.uncertainty: One producer cannot establish global shortage; H1 output grew
edges.confirm: Independent producer cuts plus farmer order delays
edges.falsify: Stable output/deliveries and adequate nutrient access

edges.initiating_stress: Temporary operating bridges expire before recurring funds
edges.mechanism: Funding gap can trigger service/staff cuts and reduce network usefulness.
buffers: Adopted bridges and potential recurring revenue
thresholds: Revenue decision fails or receipts too late; operative service-reduction decision
substitutes: Timetable integration and targeted essential-trip transport, capacity checked
edges.uncertainty: Election, receipts, expenses and ridership unresolved
edges.falsify: Recurring revenue arrives and service maintained without accumulating unsafe deferrals

edges.initiating_stress: Loss of affordable accessible essential trips
edges.mechanism: Patients and workers may miss appointments/shifts if alternatives cannot carry them.
buffers: Current service, paratransit and appointment coordination
thresholds: Documented missed essential trips with no usable accessible alternative
substitutes: Targeted ride pool; suitable remote appointment; neighborhood service access
edges.time_horizon: Days to months after service change
edges.uncertainty: No measured local effect established in this cycle
edges.confirm: Attendance/staffing impairment follows specified service loss
edges.falsify: Essential access maintained or alternative funded with real capacity

edges.initiating_stress: Local outage outlasts utility operational backup
edges.mechanism: Pumping/treatment depend on power and supported equipment.
buffers: Network switching, stored water and backup if verified
thresholds: Actual outage plus verified backup/pressure/treatment limit reached
substitutes: Alternate power; approved potable supply and conservation
edges.uncertainty: Conceptual dependency; no local outage or backup shortfall established
edges.confirm: Utility incident notice documents power-driven service impairment
edges.falsify: Verified redundancy keeps required flow/treatment through outage

edges.mechanism: Essential care can require water, sanitation and functioning local utilities.
buffers: Facility continuity arrangements subject to verification
thresholds: Operator confirms inability to sustain essential service
substitutes: Alternate clinical site and official distribution support
edges.uncertainty: No hospital-specific capacity or failure inferred
edges.confirm: Public facility service interruption/transfer notice linked to water
edges.falsify: Water and sanitation maintained within facility requirements

edges.initiating_stress: Changed duties or route constraints raise equipment landed costs
edges.mechanism: Budgeted repair may be delayed if actual quotes exceed finance and substitutes fail specification.
buffers: Supplier alternatives; targeted exemptions/incentives if eligible; spending priorities
thresholds: Bid/lead-time evidence AND documented repair deferral attributable to affected item
edges.uncertainty: BART deferrals not shown caused by tariffs; legal rate depends on product/origin
edges.confirm: Procurement records connect tariff/delivery shock to reduced repair scope
edges.falsify: Quotes recover, rules mitigate costs, or repairs proceed on time

edges.initiating_stress: Necessary repair cannot obtain compatible equipment
edges.mechanism: Specific damaged equipment may delay restoration even with ample generation.
buffers: Compatible spares, mutual aid, qualified repairs
thresholds: Public operator confirms equipment shortfall delays restoration
substitutes: Certified refurbishment or mobile unit if compatible
edges.time_horizon: Days for available spares; much longer if manufacturing required
edges.uncertainty: No current numerical lead time or facility shortfall verified
edges.falsify: Repair times normal and compatible replacement available
edges.activation_status: Scenario only; supplier lead-time refresh required

edges.mechanism: Voluntary supported retraining and hiring can move compatible skills into repair/logistics needs.
buffers: Income support and employer training if available
thresholds: Verified vacancies and compatible skills with paid transition
substitutes: Adjacent role training, apprenticeships and shared services
edges.uncertainty: Information-sector losses do not equal available electricians or nurses
edges.confirm: Actual placements with retained income and service gains
edges.falsify: No matching demand, training funds or realistic qualification path

edges.mechanism: Trust erosion may impair cooperation if documented intimidation blocks service decisions.
buffers: Transparent decisions, trusted intermediaries, inclusive conflict resolution
thresholds: Independent evidence of organization, capability AND obstructive behavior
edges.uncertainty: No current escalating cluster established; ordinary anger/activism not a threat indicator
edges.confirm: Documented organized intimidation paired with operational interference
edges.falsify: Disagreement remains nonviolent and cooperation/decision capacity holds

COMMUNITY_COMMONS.name: Braided Bridge essential-trip pilot
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.status: Reviewable proposal; no outreach, commitments or deployment
who_can_act: Two or three consenting nonprofits or neighborhood groups
first_steps: Start with one repeat supply run and a small number of essential appointments.
Map existing public transit first, then match usable seats/cargo windows without harming accessibility.
Offer a draft contribution cap and mileage reimbursement approach for partner review.
Trial only after driver, vehicle, liability and accessible-trip requirements are confirmed.
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.protected_floor: Each partner retains its ordinary service commitments, driver rest and a replenishable emergency reserve. No assumed access to another organization vehicle.
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.success_measure: Completed essential trips, cost per completed trip, empty miles and missed pickups; compare with baseline.
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.recordkeeping: Coordinator maintains public directory and plan. A designated partner dispatcher holds minimal operational records only if pilot adopted; no client-sensitive data in public state.

COMMUNITY_COMMONS.name: Small food aggregation and cold-chain map
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.status: Reviewable proposal; no outreach, commitments or deployment
who_can_act: Food bank partners, kitchens, local businesses and a nonprofit
first_steps: Use ACCFB public food locator to seed nearby options.
Record public pickup windows; keep proposed storage capacity unknown until operator confirmation.
Begin with shelf-stable aggregation; add perishables only with verified temperature-safe storage and transport.
Identify a second node on a different outage dependency before relying on one fridge.
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.protected_floor: Maintain existing client allotments, host staff time and normal food safety; no speculative stockpiling.
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.success_measure: Useful food delivered per trip; spoilage and missed pickups; host workload.
resources: No cold-storage partner is currently committed
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.recordkeeping: Coordinator maintains public directory and plan. A designated partner dispatcher holds minimal operational records only if pilot adopted; no client-sensitive data in public state.

COMMUNITY_COMMONS.name: Repair and tools exchange
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.status: Reviewable proposal; no outreach, commitments or deployment
who_can_act: Tenant association, maker space, union local or community group
first_steps: Use Oakland Tool Lending Library eligibility and borrowing rules for eligible participants.
Separate ordinary household repairs from work requiring qualified trades.
Create one recurring skills-sharing session around actual repair demand.
Use paid/voluntary capacity with explicit limits; do not assume unemployed workers are free labor.
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.protected_floor: Keep tool lending access equitable; cap volunteer hours; no unqualified electrical or structural work.
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.success_measure: Items safely repaired, money saved and participant time; no crisis required.
resources: Oakland Tool Lending Library, 5205 Telegraph Avenue; published service listing
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.recordkeeping: Coordinator maintains public directory and plan. A designated partner dispatcher holds minimal operational records only if pilot adopted; no client-sensitive data in public state.

COMMUNITY_COMMONS.name: One-room communications lifeboat
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.status: Reviewable proposal; no outreach, commitments or deployment
who_can_act: Library, church, school or nonprofit with a willing host
first_steps: Choose the essential function: charging/communications and public information.
List host critical loads and measure power/duration needs before proposing hardware.
Check a different communications path and reachable alternate location.
Tabletop an outage with a named host and hours; mark untested functions as unavailable.
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.protected_floor: Host ordinary services and safety first. Exclude life-support or clinical equipment without a responsible qualified plan.
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.success_measure: Verified usable hours, accessible capacity and successful handoff to alternate site.
resources: West Oakland/Richmond hub projects are leads only
No site commissioning or backup duration verified
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.recordkeeping: Coordinator maintains public directory and plan. A designated partner dispatcher holds minimal operational records only if pilot adopted; no client-sensitive data in public state.

COMMUNITY_COMMONS.name: Small grower input-efficiency cooperative
who_can_act: Community gardens, small farms and a cooperative extension or qualified agronomy partner
first_steps: Share crop/soil testing costs where appropriate.
Compare equivalent nutrient needs and public supplier options without substituting one nutrient for another.
Pool compatible orders only when storage, timing and payment protect every member.
Assess safe local nutrient recovery as a separate longer-term project.
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.protected_floor: Protect crop requirements, safe material use and small growers cash buffers; no stockpile that burdens participants.
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.success_measure: Useful nutrient delivered on time, cost per appropriate application and avoided waste.
resources: Qualified agronomy and current supplier evidence still to be selected
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.recordkeeping: Coordinator maintains public evidence and proposal; operational soil/farm information stays with consenting participants.

COMMUNITY_COMMONS.name: Shared reserve and fair-allocation agreement
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.status: Reviewable proposal; no evidence of an active local escalation cluster
who_can_act: Several nonprofits, tenant groups, library/community representatives
first_steps: Define which essential functions each participant protects first.
Publish simple contribution limits, access criteria and a way to request review of an allocation.
Choose trusted facilitators and an accessible feedback channel.
Practice an ordinary service disruption and record successful cooperation, not only conflict.
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.protected_floor: No identities or political positions scored as threats; no donor pressured below its service floor.
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.success_measure: Requests resolved, equitable access, preserved donor service and fewer avoidable handoff failures.
resources: Existing civic networks; facilitator availability unverified
COMMUNITY_COMMONS.recordkeeping: Coordinator keeps the public agreement draft; use aggregate outcomes and no individual threat profiles.

QUESTIONS_TO_WATCH.question: Do sulfur/phosphate pressures persist across independent producers and farm orders?

QUESTIONS_TO_WATCH.revisit_trigger: Independent producer cut or delivered order delay

QUESTIONS_TO_WATCH.question: Which local hub functions actually operate independently?
QUESTIONS_TO_WATCH.why_it_matters: A listed building or installed panel is not an operational lifeboat.
QUESTIONS_TO_WATCH.next_public_action: Seek commissioning documents, public opening/access information, power/islanding specifications and drills; unknown stays unknown.

QUESTIONS_TO_WATCH.question: Can the Saudi/European October delivery report be independently confirmed?

QUESTIONS_TO_WATCH.question: What are current transformer and repair-equipment lead times?

QUESTIONS_TO_WATCH.next_public_action: Read manufacturer/utility procurement and current commissioning disclosures; obtain public item-specific delivery intervals.
QUESTIONS_TO_WATCH.revisit_trigger: Public lead-time update or equipment-caused restoration delay

QUESTIONS_TO_WATCH.question: Do tariffs measurably change particular repair bids?
QUESTIONS_TO_WATCH.why_it_matters: Avoid attributing all maintenance problems to trade policy.
QUESTIONS_TO_WATCH.next_public_action: Match HTS/product/origin and current CBP guidance to public bids; compare quotes before/after and competing causes.

QUESTIONS_TO_WATCH.question: What current water and care continuity indicators can be verified?

QUESTIONS_TO_WATCH.next_public_action: Find dated EBMUD supply/board reports and public healthcare service/utility continuity notices; do not infer hospital vulnerabilities.

QUESTIONS_TO_WATCH.question: Are social tensions translating into organized harmful behavior or resolving?
QUESTIONS_TO_WATCH.why_it_matters: Anger alone is not a danger measure; annual crime data lag.
QUESTIONS_TO_WATCH.next_public_action: Use locality-matched public incident/court records, trust surveys and credible civic reports; track rhetoric/organization/capacity/behavior/violence separately and mediation outcomes.
QUESTIONS_TO_WATCH.revisit_trigger: Corroborated behavior or measured de-escalation; no identity profiling

QUESTIONS_TO_WATCH.question: How much help can each outside reserve safely export?
QUESTIONS_TO_WATCH.why_it_matters: Prevents donor exhaustion and common-hazard failure.
